scope: New runner, candidate binding adapter, evaluator, preparation code and resulting nonclinical metadata; old evaluator and estimator code only for reference-schema compatibility. Evidence-use pure gate has its own engineer review; runtime availability is a separate root preflight.

boundary.test_inputs: Mocked execution/state, inert candidate bytes, synthetic aggregate dictionaries and four explicitly artificial rows with the estimator mocked for endpoint inventory. No sampled cohort or scientific model was generated.
boundary.exposure_note: A code-only rg search for reference-schema implementation crossed old publication/production Python files containing embedded historical outcome prose. No reference JSON or participant/generated table was opened. These summaries did not enter packets, endpoint choices or candidate decisions. Subsequent inspection was narrowed to exact evaluator/estimator functions.

corrected_findings.finding: Protocol validation accepted arbitrary distinct seeds and did not require the declared versioned adapters.
corrected_findings.correction: Require exact initial 9100/revision 9110, final 9101/9102/9103 and semantic_feedback_v1/evidence_use_v1.

corrected_findings.finding: Verification reran evidence-use validation but did not rerun semantic preflight or explicitly enforce the pilot's program route.
corrected_findings.correction: Verify semantic preflight equality and generator.py route; require program-only files before freeze.

corrected_findings.finding: A revision could omit actual initial feedback bytes from its checks artifacts.
corrected_findings.correction: Before revised freeze and during revised verification, require every actual initial feedback SHA256 among checked, byte-verified candidate artifacts. Later revision feedback remains bound by the final decision rather than retroactively changing frozen bytes.

corrected_findings.finding: A resolved failed trial could previously qualify its candidate for final selection.
corrected_findings.correction: Final selection requires exactly one successful trial with verified receipt/table bindings for the chosen candidate. A failed revision can retain a successfully tried initial candidate; neither failed candidate can be delivered.

corrected_findings.finding: The direct load_references helper relied on its caller for the six-session closure gate.
corrected_findings.correction: The helper now checks closure before any reference hash or JSON read. The evaluate entrypoint retains its own gate; the duplicate is intentional.

confirmed: Six authors, three ENSANUT2018 and three Turkana, distinct new bundles, whole_cohort and 3000 rows.
Task budgets are four query credits, two new original downloads, one revision; curated source IDs remain separate. Controller rejects over-budget acquisition before input commitment.
Attempt reservation precedes adapter invocation; synthetic adapter failure consumes the slot and retry is rejected. Final delivery visits exactly three fixed seeds and closes scientific changes.
All-six batch closure and the global 30-attempt upper bound are covered with synthetic ledgers.
Candidate binding adapter rejects substitution of task paths; baseline path selection is controller-owned.
Current prepared lipid endpoint names use sex.F_fraction and match the provider. The earlier mismatch warning referred to a pre-root-patch read; no provider edit was made.

Endpoint contract, controller, providers, harness modules, K02 estimator and ENSANUT analytical engine are included in control_files; exact task/request hashes appear in protocol and source trees become immutable at initialization.

Existing ENSANUT evaluator code emits references[case][endpoint]. Existing lipid evaluator code emits publishable references['K02'] from the same K02 analyzer; estimands and metric_denominators.sample_sd mapping matches. No actual aggregate was parsed.
Lipid reference mapping uses exactly its three estimands and two sample SDs; unmatched generated diagnostics remain unavailable for reference comparison. Synthetic mapping test confirms this.
Every final decision must bind every actual feedback report, including retention; revised checks additionally preserve initial report bytes.
